The increase in property tax growth within the increment financing area is above the 1% threshold that a jurisdiction could typically collect, which is how we're keeping those special purpose districts whole. The project is required to use and, required to complete an impact analysis and provide a mitigation plan to ensure that existing businesses and housing are being well thought of in terms of their future and any project that moves forward.
